title: Strictly use the audio Rising demo.mp3 and the character cowboy.png as the main…
content: Strictly use the audio Rising demo.mp3 and the character cowboy.png as the main protagonist to generate a Wes Anderson‑style musical dance MV. You may define the other characters in the MV yourself. The setting is a town fair in the American countryside, based on the scene in town.png. While keeping camera angles varied, maintain perfectly symmetrical composition in every shot. Include some playful close‑ups of body parts (e.g., hands, feet, hats) for added character. Avoid making the characters look too identical to reduce the AI‑generated feel.
